text:
emily: Quick sync on bulk rotate/revoke UX. Need sign-off on preview and wording.
rachel: Bulk revoke is risky. Must show impact preview and require explicit confirmation checkbox.
tom: Preview should list affected services and last-used time; collapsible per-service.
juan: Gate by role — org-admins only? Also CLI helper for rotation would be handy.
olga: Accessibility: announce preview counts with aria-live and ensure focus management.
emily: Draft copy: "Revoke 12 keys? This will invalidate keys immediately and may interrupt services. Preview below. You have 30s to undo." Thoughts?
rachel: "May interrupt" is vague. Suggest: "Some services will stop working until a replacement key is provided." 
tom: UX: default action should be 'Preview impact' not immediate revoke; disable table multi-select direct revoke.
juan: Backend note: capped preview (first 200 keys) and show 'more' note; include last-IP where available.
infra-bot: bulk-revoke-soft-delete feature-flag enabled for internal staging.
emily: Action items: 1) add preview UI mock, 2) add checkbox copy "I understand these keys will stop working immediately and I have a replacement plan.", 3) design undo snackbar 30s.
olga: Also ensure danger color meets contrast AA and masked keys in preview.
tom: Add rotate-recommendation badge for keys expiring within 7 days.
emily: I'll update Figma and ping infra for API flag timeline. Leave final nits here before EOD. :thumbsup:
